title: Scenario 2 knowledge check
notes: PROVISIONAL INSTRUMENT. These items were drafted for the FarmSim prototype and have NOT been reviewed or approved by a supervisor. Review and revise before any study use. Editing this file is enough to change the instrument - no code changes are required.

questions.text: How was a pest problem detected on a tile during this scenario?
options: It was announced for every affected tile individually
By scouting tiles to reveal their condition, and by the warning marker on affected tiles
It could not be detected until harvest
questions.explanation: The outbreak was announced, but finding which tiles were affected needed the monitor to go and look.

questions.text: What happened on infested tiles that were left untreated?
options: Pest pressure kept rising, condition kept dropping, and the problem could spread to neighbouring tiles
questions.explanation: Damage accumulated for as long as the pests were left, and neighbouring tiles could become infested too.

questions.text: While one player was dealing with the outbreak, what was the most useful thing for the other player to do?
options: Carry on with sowing and irrigation so the rest of the field kept progressing
questions.explanation: Splitting the work meant the outbreak was handled without the rest of the field falling behind - which is the point of having two complementary roles.
